about: THE GILDED ACORN (f3_lounge_classic) review views. Venue frame: world x = 1487 + X, z = -362 - D, y = 9.5 + Y (X across the frontage, D into the building, Y up from the floor). Make: lune run tools/bake/main.luau (+ editor_ground, attractions, backdrop); lune run tools/bake/lounge_classic.luau; lune run tools/review/export.luau; lune run tools/review/lounge_classic.luau; then /root/.cache/spicy-rodents/venv/bin/python -I tools/review/render.py --scene build/review/lounge_scene.json --views docs/renders/lounge_classic/views.json --out build/review/lounge --threads 2. The view from above uses the cutaway scene (lune run tools/review/lounge_classic.luau --cutaway --out build/review/lounge_cut.json; render with --set cutaway); the Blender pieces use the art scene (python -I tools/blender/lounge_classic/model.py; lune run tools/review/lounge_classic.luau --art build/art/lounge_classic --out build/review/lounge_art.json; render with --set art). Interior views are at a person's eye (floor + 5.2). Cycles bounces light off the walls and Roblox's lighting does not: in the engine the corners and the ceiling will be darker than here.

views.name: lc_01_street
views.desc: From Bowl Lane, 40 st in front, at a person's eye: the black-and-gold front, the sign, the crown and acorn.

views.name: lc_02_door
views.desc: On the forecourt between the guards' posts (local 0, D -31): the ropes, the steps, the canopy and the double door.

views.name: lc_03_from_door
views.desc: Just inside the door (local 0, 5.2, -19), to the back wall: the rug, the chandeliers, the bar, the stage.

views.name: lc_04_bar
views.desc: At the end of the stools (local 11, 5.2, 12), along the bar to the back bar, the urn, the snow-cone machine.

views.name: lc_05_from_bar
views.desc: From behind the bar, beside the bartender (local 3, 5.4, 21), back toward the door.

views.name: lc_06_stage
views.desc: From the rug (local -4, 5.2, 4) toward the stage: the grand piano, the microphone, the drapes, the radio.

views.name: lc_07_booths
views.desc: From the west booths (local -12, 5.2, -14) across to the east booths and the fireplace.

views.name: lc_08_above
views.desc: From above, the building on its site: the roof behind its parapet, the front, the forecourt.

views.name: lc_09_cutaway
views.desc: From above with the ceiling and roof left out (the cutaway scene): the whole room's plan.

views.name: lc_10_art_bar
views.desc: The Blender pieces (the art scene): the bar from the rug (local 4, 5.2, 6): reeded pilasters, tufted leather, the bullnosed top, the brass rail.

views.name: lc_11_art_booths
views.desc: The Blender pieces: the east booths and the wainscot from the rug (local 8, 5.2, -3).
